MKT-E001.finding: Formative assessment is positively related to maths achievement, which supports the value of diagnosis.
MKT-E001.limitation: Academic study, abstract-level; not evidence of purchasing by Singapore tuition centres. Gap: Does not address primary-level diagnosis tools or purchasing by tuition centres.

MKT-E022.finding: The study found that middle school mathematics teachers resort to conventional methods and struggle to thoroughly diagnose student misconceptions in algebra, making the diagnostic process demanding and time-consuming, which supports the claim about the effort required for gap diagnosis.
MKT-E022.limitation: It focuses on middle school algebra in state schools rather than primary mathematics or tuition centres in Singapore.

MKT-E036.finding: Human experts gave more nuanced feedback than ChatGPT-4o and Perplexity, which indirectly supports the value of tutor review over automated feedback alone.
MKT-E036.limitation: Preservice teacher training in mixed-reality simulations on controversial issues, not commercial maths diagnostics for tuition centres. Does not measure what tuition centres expect or would pay for.

MKT-E037.finding: With sources disclosed, students showed bias against AI-only feedback, while human-AI co-produced feedback kept its positive perception; this indirectly supports adding tutor review to AI diagnosis.
MKT-E037.limitation: Undergraduate students' perceptions of feedback in higher education, not primary maths diagnostics or tuition centres; measures student trust, not what centres value or would pay for. When blinded, students rated AI-only feedback as useful as co-produced feedback.

MKT-E008.finding: Geniebook offers personalised practice targeting learning gaps and combines qualified teachers with technology, so learning-gap targeting with human involvement already exists in the market.
MKT-E008.limitation: Company self-description, not independently tested. Sold to parents (B2C) with its own teachers, not as a tool for tuition centres; no mention of evidence-traceable gap reports. Contradicts MKT-02-A only in part.
